code = '''import random

N = 100
trials = 200000
ejected_counts = [0] * (N + 1)

for _ in range(trials):
    ramp_next = 4
    platform = [1, 2, 3]
    
    while platform:
        p = random.randint(0, 2)
        
        if len(platform) == 3:
            if p == 0:
                ejected = platform[0]
                ejected_counts[ejected] += 1
                b2, b3 = platform[1], platform[2]
                platform = [b2, b3]
                if ramp_next <= N:
                    platform.append(ramp_next)
                    ramp_next += 1
            elif p == 1:
                ejected = platform[1]
                ejected_counts[ejected] += 1
                b3 = platform[2]
                platform = [b3]
                if ramp_next <= N:
                    platform.append(ramp_next)
                    ramp_next += 1
                if ramp_next <= N:
                    platform.append(ramp_next)
                    ramp_next += 1
            elif p == 2:
                ejected = platform[2]
                ejected_counts[ejected] += 1
                b2 = platform[1]
                platform = [b2]
                if ramp_next <= N:
                    platform.append(ramp_next)
                    ramp_next += 1
                if ramp_next <= N:
                    platform.append(ramp_next)
                    ramp_next += 1
        else:
            p = random.randint(0, len(platform) - 1)
            ejected = platform.pop(p)
            ejected_counts[ejected] += 1

probs = {i: ejected_counts[i] / trials for i in range(1, N + 1)}
sorted_probs = sorted(probs.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
print("Top 10 highest probability balls:")
for ball, prob in sorted_probs[:10]:
    print(f"Ball {ball}: {prob:.5f}")
'''
